name: YuXiang Li
biography: YuXiang Li is a senior security researcher at Tencent Blade Team, specialized in the study of Mobile Security and IoT Security. He has reported multiple vulnerabilities of Android and received acknowledgments from vendors(Google/Huawei). He was a speaker of HITB AMS 2018 and XCON 2018. Twitter: @Xbalien29
